# Vendored from the original experiment

Files `mathqa.py`, `st_numpy.py`, `apply_edit.py`, `merge.py` are copied unchanged from
https://github.com/RikiyaT/lm_understand-logs (`exp8_math/code/`), MIT License,
Copyright (c) 2026 the authors of "LLMs can understand and write neural network weights".
`../edits/p{10,25,50}c/` are the published weight edits (`exp8_math/runs/*/edit/`, CC BY 4.0).
`mcqa.py` is our stub: the original module is not released, and mathqa.py only uses it for a loop diagnostic.
